resolutions.resolution: Complete application/frontend, account isolation, protections and agent source trees preserved. No proprietary carve-out is claimed. Per-version source mapping and a source-offer publication kit are included. Actual hosting and prominent integration require the separately approved release. Login legal copy clarified: software license rights are not restricted by hosted-service terms. Access-control and authorization logic are unchanged.
Apache license and upstream notices preserved; local modifications marked. Verified v0.4.4 baseline and local file comparisons retained.

Historical MIT license and later attribution text both retained. Visible acp-kernel credit with upstream link is included in the source offer, README and notices. Exact original working checkout is unknown and is not claimed. No relicensing of upstream code.

Six original content blobs verified against two equivalent upstream subset trees; official upstream MIT text and copyright restored. Both possible revisions documented. No runtime PoC is executed or separately packaged.

MIT license and copyright included for any adapted material; pinned comparison source and hash included. No assertion that React is a literal Vue copy or that a unique original checkout was recovered.

All 52 declared module archives included with locked h1 sums, archive hashes, original nested license and notice files. Linked dependency versions matched historical binary metadata in the prior independent build.

Both unchanged lockfiles and 588 exact registry locators/integrities supplied. No npm package archive, node_modules, native library or generated JS bundle is redistributed here. Existing 481 available notices retained. This does not clear a future compiled frontend or native package distribution.

lightningcss and sharp/libvips native packages are external build dependencies, not shipped source changes or native binaries in this package. Versions, source locators and license expressions retained. A future distribution containing those libraries requires its own corresponding-source/relinking and notice review.

Frontend MIT and shadcn MIT notices retained. Geist OFL text and copyright retained; font binaries are obtained from the external locked geist package and are not included separately in this source package. Future generated font assets retain OFL terms. External CC-BY/CC0 metadata and notices preserved.

Historical recipes remain as source reference, with an explicit no-container/no-third-party-tool-binary scope. No image, OS package, external tool checkout, browser or lab image is distributed or cleared here.
